categories.name: mining
categories.evidence: Changes getblocktemplate and generateblock error handling in src/rpc/mining.cpp when createNewBlock() returns nullptr.
categories.rationale: Fixes mining RPCs to cleanly handle shutdown rather than triggering a CHECK_NONFATAL assertion. When getblocktemplate longpolls or runs during node shutdown, createNewBlock() returns nullptr, which previously raised a non-fatal assertion reporting an internal bug.

categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Labeled RPC/REST/ZMQ and modifies error handling in src/rpc/mining.cpp to return standard RPC_CLIENT_NOT_CONNECTED on shutdown.
categories.rationale: Ensures standard RPC error codes are returned instead of internal assertion errors during shutdown. Rather than reporting a non-fatal internal bug, getblocktemplate and generateblock throw standard RPC_CLIENT_NOT_CONNECTED ('Shutting down') errors.
